workerResult.summary: Static Picnic — a pop-art radio potluck for passing strangers. Dish Tuner: a keyboard-navigable radio dial (87.5–108 MHz, ←/→/Home/End tune, Enter locks) with a live signal meter, static flicker and crackle that reveals stranger dishes. Picnic Board: locking a dish auto-lays out a tilted plate card on a localStorage rug where you can pin a note for the host. Signal Seats: a row of claimable seats around the transmitter with per-seat connection strength, persisted in localStorage. Easter egg: tune past the band edge to 66.6 FM THE VOID — the palette inverts and a focus-trapped dialog (Esc or button dismisses) appears. Fully keyboard-only with visible focus rings and prefers-reduced-motion support. Pop-art identity: bone/pink/canary/acid-green/cobalt palette, Bungee + Space Grotesk + Space Mono, halftone dots, sunburst, hard offset shadows, tilted asymmetric layout. Build passes with relative asset paths for /p/ subpath hosting.
